name: eeprom_emulation
description: EEPROM_Emulation (Applications/EEPROM): three 16-bit variables (virtual addresses 0x5555, 0x6666, 0x7777) kept in flash sectors 2 and 3, each write a halfword programmed after the last, a full page's valid values copied to the other and the full one erased. The application writes and reads back the first variable 0x1000 times, the second 0x2000 and the third 0x3000, checking each read, then reads all three again: LD2 stays dark while it works (an error would toggle it) and turns on when every value read back right, VarDataTab holding 0x1000, 0x2000 and 0x3000. Sector 2 (0x08008000) ends as the valid page (its status 0x0000), sector 3 erased.
